title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single card. At the top is the product mark "ANDS Studio" with a dot icon, and at the right of that row an "EN"/"FR" language toggle; pressing "FR" switches the card's leading copy to French. Below the mark is the heading "Sign in" and one line of grey text: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." Under that, a maple-leaf line notes ANDS Studio is self-hosted so your data can stay resident in Canada. Then come labeled fields "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password", a primary "Sign in →" button beside a plain-text "New here? Create a workspace" button, and a smaller "Forgot password?" button. The primary button stays disabled until both fields are filled and reads "Working…" while submitting; Enter in the password field also submits. A thin rule separates a single closing link: "Enterprise SSO on the roadmap →".

Signing into an MFA-enabled account reveals an "Authenticator code" field (placeholder "6-digit code") with helper text noting multi-factor authentication (a hover-defined term) is enabled; enter the current 6-digit code. A wrong code returns "That code didn't verify — codes rotate every 30 seconds; try the current one."

Clicking "New here? Create a workspace" swaps the heading to "Create your workspace" with a "What is a workspace?" hover term. A "Who are you filing for?" choice offers "Your own company" or "On behalf of clients (CRO)", and the subtext, company-name label and placeholder adjust ("Your company name" / "Acme Therapeutics Inc." versus "Client company name" / "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). As you type a password, live helper text shows "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.", counts down remaining characters if short, and flips to "✓ Meets the password rules." Buttons become "Create workspace →" and "Have an account? Sign in".

"Forgot password?" changes the heading to "Reset your password" and explains a one-time code (15-minute expiry). You enter your email and click "Send me a code →". A notice states this is a demo environment with no outbound email; the code stays hidden behind a "Reveal demo code" button (toggling to "Hide"). Fields "One-time code" (placeholder "8-digit code") and "New password" follow; "Set new password →" returns you to sign-in with a confirmation. A "Back to sign in" button is always present; errors show in a red box.

After signing in, a yellow strip across every page reads "Demo / evaluation environment — nothing here is transmitted to Health Canada and no email is sent." A shared top bar carries the "ANDS Studio" mark and icon chips — "Journey", "Dossiers", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", "Help" — each with a hover tooltip; the current page is highlighted. At the right, a user chip shows your initial, email, workspace and a caret; clicking it opens a dropdown repeating your email and workspace with "Account & security" and a red "Sign out". A dismissible "What you'll do here" primer (badged "New to ANDS? Start here") appears once, ending with a one-line security summary of session length, idle lockout and MFA posture.

The Account & security page stacks cards. "Who you are here" shows your email, workspace and role, with a "Your role" chip and plain label plus a collapsed "What can each role do? ▼" expander; expanded, roles read as plain names (Platform vendor / Workspace admin / Company member) with the code key beside each, and the vendor role sits behind a further "Advanced / vendor roles ▼" expander. "Multi-factor authentication" offers "Set up authenticator app →" (a secret, "Copy setup link", then a verify step). "Workspace security policy" shows "Required for all members ✓" or "Optional per member" (with a "Recommended: Required" chip and admin toggle) plus session-length and idle-lockout dropdowns, honest that these are a documented target. "Password & sessions" and "Deployment & data residency" state the rules, with an "Audit & compliance" section: a 21 CFR Part 11 / GxP alignment statement (explicitly not a certification), a sign-in/security event log, and an "Export security settings & role table (PDF)" button. A closing "Roadmap — not yet available" card lists SSO, SCIM and SIEM streaming with target quarters, "why you'd care" lines and "Request early access / notify me" controls.
